comparison.objective: Raise probes, index a wafer, then restore probe contact without scratching.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-aside and stage motion with cumulative contact-damage avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Correct wafer index and restored probes with zero latched scrape; exact pose and travel thresholds are absent from the record.
comparison.reason: Both penalize damaging lateral contact, but the central ability here is damage-free indexed motion under raised probes, not controlled impact fracture and debris recovery.
